newsitem.title: USA: Geotek names CFO, president/COO leaving.
newsitem.headline: Geotek names CFO, president/COO leaving.

text.p: Geotek Communications Inc said Monday that President and Chief Operating Officer Jonathan Crane was leaving the company and that his responsibilities would be assumed by Yaron Eitan, chairman and chief executive.
Geotek said it does not expect to name a new president and COO in the foreseeable future.
Geotek said it had named Robert Kerstein as chief financial officer, replacing Michael Carus, who had held the position on a temporary basis.
Kerstein was most recently chief financial officer of Pocket Communications, a provider of personal communications services, the company said.
It said that Carus will resume his role as vice president, corporate controller and chief accounting officer.
Crane, who is also stepping down as a director, will remain a consultant to the company.

Geotek said it had named Zvi Peled as president and chief executive of its wholly owned subsidiary Geotek Technologies Inc, and William Opet was named president and chief executive of its newly formed mobile data business unit.
